CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.correct_pharmacy_learned_gtin_v2(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_gtin text, p_new_item_code text, p_new_item_name text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare

    v_gtin text :=
        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(p_gtin,''),
            '[^0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
        );

    v_code text :=
        trim(coalesce(p_new_item_code,''));

    v_name text :=
        trim(coalesce(p_new_item_name,''));

    v_reason text :=
        trim(coalesce(p_reason,''));

    v_old public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_v1%rowtype;

begin

    if auth.uid() is null
       or not public.pharmflow_is_member(p_pharmacy_id)
    then
        raise exception 'Pharmacy access required';
    end if;

    -- System Owner OR pharmacy ADMIN
    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.system_owners so
        where so.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.pharmacy_members pm
        where pm.pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
          and pm.user_id = auth.uid()
          and pm.active = true
          and lower(coalesce(pm.role,'')) = 'admin'
    )
    then
        raise exception
            'Pharmacy ADMIN access is required for GTIN corrections';
    end if;

    if length(v_gtin) < 8
       or v_code = ''
       or v_name = ''
       or v_reason = ''
    then
        raise exception
            'GTIN, Item Code, Item Name and Reason are required';
    end if;

    select *
      into v_old
      from public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_v1
     where pharmacy_id = p_pharmacy_id
       and regexp_replace(
               gtin,
               '[^0-9]',
               '',
               'g'
           ) = v_gtin
     limit 1
     for update;

    if v_old.id is null then
        raise exception
            'No pharmacy-learned mapping exists for this GTIN';
    end if;

    insert into
    public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_audit_v1 (

        pharmacy_id,
        gtin,

        old_item_code,
        old_item_name,

        new_item_code,
        new_item_name,

        action,
        reason,

        changed_by

    )
    values (

        p_pharmacy_id,
        v_gtin,

        v_old.item_code,
        v_old.item_name,

        v_code,
        v_name,

        'CORRECT',
        v_reason,

        auth.uid()

    );

    update public.pharmflow_pharmacy_gtin_v1
       set item_code  = v_code,
           item_name  = v_name,
           updated_by = auth.uid(),
           updated_at = now()
     where id = v_old.id;

    return jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'scope', 'pharmacy',
        'action', 'CORRECT',
        'gtin', v_gtin,
        'old_item_code', v_old.item_code,
        'new_item_code', v_code
    );

end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.count_pharmflow_needs_review_scope_v3(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_workflow text DEFAULT 'RECEIVING'::text, p_order_numbers text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_count integer;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_pharmacy_member(p_pharmacy_id) then raise exception 'Pharmacy access required'; end if;
 select count(*)::integer into v_count from (
   select r.gtin,coalesce(r.order_number,''),r.review_reason
   from public.pharmflow_needs_review_v2 r
   where r.pharmacy_id=p_pharmacy_id and r.status='PENDING'
     and r.workflow=upper(trim(coalesce(p_workflow,'RECEIVING')))
     and coalesce(array_length(p_order_numbers,1),0)>0
     and r.order_number=any(p_order_numbers)
   group by r.gtin,coalesce(r.order_number,''),r.review_reason
 ) g;
 return coalesce(v_count,0);
end $function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_pharmflow_needs_review_v3(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_workflow text, p_identifier_display text, p_raw_barcode text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_session_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_order_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_order_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_review_reason text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN_GTIN'::text, p_master_item_code_hint text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_master_item_name_hint text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'HANDHELD'::text, p_device_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(review_id uuid, pending_quantity integer, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ declare v_display text:=btrim(coalesce(p_identifier_display,''));v_key text:=public.pharmflow_identifier_key_v2(p_identifier_display);v_id uuid;v_time timestamptz;begin if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_pharmacy_member(p_pharmacy_id) then raise exception 'Pharmacy access required';end if;if v_key='' then raise exception 'Identifier is required';end if;if upper(trim(coalesce(p_workflow,'RECEIVING'))) <> 'RECEIVING' then raise exception 'Invalid workflow';end if;if upper(btrim(coalesce(p_review_reason,'UNKNOWN_GTIN'))) not in ('UNKNOWN_GTIN','KNOWN_NOT_IN_ORDER','MANUAL_REQUIRED') then raise exception 'Invalid review reason';end if;if upper(btrim(coalesce(p_source,'HANDHELD'))) not in ('HANDHELD','PC') then raise exception 'Invalid source';end if;insert into public.pharmflow_needs_review_v2(pharmacy_id,workflow,session_id,order_number,order_name,gtin,raw_barcode,identifier_display,identifier_key,pending_quantity,review_reason,master_item_code_hint,master_item_name_hint,source,device_id,created_by) values(p_pharmacy_id,'RECEIVING',nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_session_id,'')),''),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_order_number,'')),''),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_order_name,'')),''),v_display,nullif(p_raw_barcode,''),v_display,v_key,1,upper(btrim(coalesce(p_review_reason,'UNKNOWN_GTIN'))),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_master_item_code_hint,'')),''),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_master_item_name_hint,'')),''),upper(btrim(coalesce(p_source,'HANDHELD'))),nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_device_id,'')),''),auth.uid()) returning id,pharmflow_needs_review_v2.created_at into v_id,v_time;return query select v_id,1,v_time;end $function$
;
